statement: His level may be higher than viewer's; video is about talent priority not completing the whole build
Gilded Sword is first priority for more damage to all monsters
Sharpened Axe second for base weapon power; one of the most important early game stats
Start with 50 points in Sleepin on the Job because of diminishing returns
Sleepin on the Job gives more AFK gain rate for fighting; max it out as soon as you can
Lucky Clover is the biggest priority next; base Luck is Maestro's primary damage source and gives accuracy
Everything else on tab 1 has basically the same priority
Maestro gets damage from stacking small bonuses; Strength HP Agility movement speed Wisdom mana scale via Alchemy bubbles
Knuckle Buster and Feather Flight are good to put points in; they raise kills per hour up to map monster kill cap
Leave some tab 1 points to come back to after spending on tabs 2 and 3
Two Punch Man is the biggest tab 2 priority; max it out as fast as possible
Two Punch Man is one of Maestro's primary damage sources
Lucky Hit is next priority on tab 2; increases damage gained from Luck
Lucky Horseshoe is third priority for more base Luck
Put 55 points into each of the two active talents (tab 2 and tab 3) to cap hidden kill multiplier
While AFK with these active attacks on the bar kills per hour rise up to 2.2x
F'LUK'ey Fabrics has really bad scaling; could ignore it in favor of ChaChing or Rares Everywhere
He does not want to ignore F'LUK'ey Fabrics entirely since it is a damage boost
Put some points into ChaChing for cash and Rares Everywhere for rare drop table chances
Breakin' the Bank only useful if maxed and used on login after AFK; multiplies value of coins dropped
Put 55 points into Coin Toss on tab 3 to cap hidden kill multiplier
Skillage Damage is first tab 3 priority and Maestro's largest damage boost
Cap out Skillage Damage as soon as possible
Triple Jab is another big overall damage boost
Triple Jab does nothing unless you have points in Two Punch Man
Bliss N Chips raises max levels of Happy Dude and Lucky Horseshoe; mainly wanted for Lucky Horseshoe; max it
Colloquial Containers raises Sleeping on the Job max level on tab 1; increases AFK gain rates
Jman Was Better is biggest of the roughly equal priority group; lets you finish Lucky Horseshoe points
Lucky Charms increases class EXP gain; he likes having some points in it
Crystal Countdown is currently bugged so only one point gives maximum effectiveness; levels skills easier for more Skillage damage
Skilliest Statue boosts bonuses of EhExPee Kapow and Feasty statues
Bonuses from potions are one of the biggest damage boosts Maestro can get
Go back to tab 2 and fill out Lucky Horseshoe for more total Luck
Spend spare tab 1 points on more Sleepin on the Job; then spend rest wherever you want
Will of the Eldest gives base stats including Luck and Strength for small damage boost
Will of the Eldest is capped by highest level of each class; at around 200 he gets about 20 extra stat points
Best Beginner Class gives weapon power from best beginner class; points should match how high your Maestro is
Tick Tock is great for more AFK gain rate
Goblet of Hemoglobin is good to reduce food consumption
Attacks on Simmer increases AFK kills based on active attacks on your action bar
Quest Chungus gives total Luck based on quests completed; he has about 180 so a few points help
Dungeonic Damage gives damage based on dungeon credits ever earned; quite a big boost to total damage
Frothy Malk increases bonuses from foods; big total damage bonus when using average damage potions
Everything else on star tab 2 is optional; Printer Sampling or Telekinetic Storage for carry capacity
Always put one point into Shrine Architect
Mega Crit can be a good boost depending on total crit chance
Cardiovascular and Pulsation give small boosts if needed
Tiptoe Quickness from World 4 gives movement speed; good boost because of Alchemy bubbles
Put some points in Ubercharged Health for more base HP
OverAccurate Crit gives more crit chance
American Tipper gives more cash for Cooking skill if you have leveled cooking on this character
Quick Movement Speed potions give about 70K damage
Golden Kebabs for 5% damage give about 300K damage
Golden Nomwiches give about 100K damage
Potent Potion of Strength gives about 700K damage
Boost food Decent Strength Potion gives about 200K damage
Potions and foods together give about 1.5 million damage; a little under 25% more damage from talent points spent
